headline: Watches spotted at the 2026 F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix
stop_reason: No permitted event photo found (attempt 4). Getty is permitted in state/permissions.json, but no 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix Getty-credited photo of a celebrity or driver wearing a watch could be found or confirmed. Checked: one WebSearch returned only 2025 race coverage (Getty captions with no watch or wrist shot) and a 2026 Autosport gallery with driver/team captions only. Earlier attempts also failed on Robb Report, Yahoo Sports, newsbeep, formula1.com, geo.tv, Bytes Europe and Hauteliving (403). No project was started and nothing was rendered. The format was not switched: the approver's lesson says to switch format when no permitted photo exists, so this needs an owner decision (a Getty or brand photo supplied via owner-photos, or a different format for the rotation slot).
